# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Benjamin Strikes Down Pharaoh's Son

---

**20:1** And in the night the son of Pharaoh came with five hundred armed men and went to the house of Pentephres to kill him and his wife and to take Aseneth with him.

**20:2** And Benjamin was sitting on the gate of the house, and he saw the men coming and he cried out to his brothers Simeon and Levi: 'Behold, many armed men are approaching the gate in the night.'

**20:3** And Simeon and Levi and the other brothers all came to the gate and Levi said: 'Fear not, for the Lord God is with us, and he will fight for us.'

**20:4** And Simeon said: 'I will take my sword and kill them all.' But Levi said: 'We will not act thus, but let us call upon the name of the Lord and he will deliver us.'

**20:5** And Levi prayed to the Lord and the Lord heard his prayer. And behold, the swords of the five hundred men fell from their hands and were struck with blindness.

**20:6** And Benjamin ran to the son of Pharaoh and struck him with his right hand and knocked him off his horse and took his sword and struck him with it on his neck, but did not kill him.

**20:7** And Aseneth cried out to Benjamin from the window: 'Do not kill him, Benjamin my brother, for a man who worships God must not render evil for evil.' And Benjamin spared him.

**20:8** And the sons of Dan and Gad saw what had happened and were afraid and fled and hid themselves.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
